title: Turn Off or Limit Telemetry Trace Events

facts.text: Diagnostic Trace Level setting controls lowest severity of telemetry events emitted by Business Central server.
Custom telemetry events have IDs 700-712, separate from external proxy logging controlled by ExternalTraceLevel.
Configure Diagnostic Trace Level via Microsoft Dynamics 365 Administration tool under General settings.
Set trace level to Critical, Error, Warning, Normal (Information), Verbose, or Off.
Restart server instance for configuration changes to take effect.
Use Set-NAVServerConfiguration PowerShell cmdlet as alternative to admin tool for configuration.
SENDTRACETAG method in code generates custom telemetry events that can be filtered or suppressed.
